title: Love Is the Message
studio_context: Released as a single in 2018; the quartet also filmed an extended live version at Abbey Road Studios that year, later pressed to vinyl by The Vinyl Factory.

drum_performances.name: Yussef Dayes
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first release under his own name after Yussef Kamaal: the snare moved to the 'and' of 2, with ghost notes and a pickup into every 1.
